title: bind_component_context inputSchema
description: Argument shape for bind_component_context (composition profile, ADR-0032). Sets or clears one component's exploration-context membership, addressed by the ADR-0030 `ref` grammar (map, layer:{id}, widget:{id}, control:{id}). Because cross-filtering is identity of explorationContextId rather than an event→action edge, linking N components into one shared-state workspace is N calls to this tool, not one call per component pair. Omitting explorationContextId clears the binding and leaves the component independent. Target addressing matches the other composition tools: a composition document (mapPackageId or appPackageId) at the standard level, with the reference implementation's draft-lifecycle spelling (draftId + generation) admitted as x-honua-reference-shape. Validation gate: ref must resolve within the document, explorationContextId must resolve against the document's explorationContexts block, and role must be a member of the closed role vocabulary. See docs/adr/0032-shared-exploration-contexts.md and common/exploration.schema.json. Supplying explorationContextId requires role; omitting both clears the binding.

mapPackageId.description: Target MapPackage composition document. Exactly one of mapPackageId / appPackageId / draftId identifies the target.

appPackageId.description: Target AppPackage composition document. Exactly one of mapPackageId / appPackageId / draftId identifies the target.

draftId.description: x-honua-reference-shape: reference-implementation draft-lifecycle target. Requires generation.

generation.description: x-honua-reference-shape: optimistic-concurrency generation of the draft being mutated; the call fails on generation conflict.

ref.description: The component whose binding is being set or cleared, in the ADR-0030 reference grammar.

explorationContextId.description: Context to bind the component to. Omit to clear the component's binding; a component belongs to at most one context, so binding replaces any previous membership.

role.description: Role the component plays in the context, which the preset's propagation policy is keyed on. Meaningful only when explorationContextId is present; implementations SHOULD reject a role given without a context rather than storing an inert value.

allOf.description: A component that joins a context must declare its role. The mapDriven, gridDriven, and chartDriven presets key propagation on role, and no inference or default is specified — without it two conforming runtimes could disagree on whether the component contributes state.
